exercises.title: Present Continuous for future — Recupera
exercises.description: Impara a usare il Present Continuous per accordi futuri già organizzati e a distinguerlo dall'azione in corso adesso.
exercises.instructions: Cerca nel contesto una vera organizzazione: orario, luogo, persona, prenotazione o accordo concreto.

sections.title: Un appuntamento già organizzato
sections.instructions: Non basta parlare del futuro: serve un arrangement concreto.

questions.title: Present Continuous: dal presente a un futuro già organizzato
questions.prompt: Prima di esercitarti
questions.instructions: Osserva cosa rende l'evento davvero organizzato.
questions.learning_objective: Use Present Continuous for fixed future arrangements with clear future context and correct form.

content.body: Il Present Continuous può descrivere un accordo futuro già organizzato. La forma resta am/is/are + verbo in -ing, ma il contesto deve indicare chiaramente il futuro.
content.intro: Un'intenzione vaga non basta. Cerca elementi concreti: persona, ora, luogo, prenotazione o appuntamento.

sections.title: Arrangement già organizzato
sections.body: Usa spesso il Present Continuous quando l'evento futuro è già fissato o concordato.

examples.text: I'm meeting Sara at six outside the station tomorrow.
highlight: at six outside the station tomorrow

examples.text: We're seeing the dentist on Friday morning.

sections.title: La forma è quella del Present Continuous
sections.body: Scegli am/is/are e poi il verbo in -ing.

examples.text: They are flying to Rome on Saturday.

sections.title: Adesso o futuro?
sections.body: La stessa forma può parlare di adesso o di futuro: il contesto decide.

correct.text: I'm talking to Luca now. · I'm talking to Luca at 5 tomorrow.

sections.title: Negativa
sections.pattern: subject + am/is/are not + verb-ing + future context

sections.title: Serve un contesto futuro chiaro
sections.body: Senza contesto, una frase può sembrare semplicemente presente.

correct.text: I'm meeting the teacher at 3 tomorrow.

sections.title: Checklist
points: C'è un dettaglio concreto che lo rende un arrangement?
Il contesto indica chiaramente il futuro?

questions.title: Un accordo già fissato
questions.prompt: The appointment is booked for Friday at 10. Which sentence fits?
questions.learning_objective: Choose Present Continuous for a fixed future arrangement.

options.text: I'm seeing the dentist at ten on Friday.
I seeing the dentist at ten on Friday.
I'm see the dentist at ten on Friday.

feedback.explanation: L'appuntamento è già prenotato: Present Continuous con contesto futuro chiaro.

questions.title: Costruisci l'arrangement
questions.prompt: Completa la frase.
questions.learning_objective: Build a future arrangement with correct auxiliary and -ing form.

content.text_template: We [[blank_1]] [[blank_2]] Luca at the station at 6 tomorrow.

feedback.explanation: We → are; poi meeting. Ora e luogo rendono chiaro l'arrangement.

questions.title: Adesso o domani?
questions.prompt: Which sentence clearly refers to a future arrangement?
questions.learning_objective: Distinguish future arrangement from present action using context.

options.text: I'm meeting the manager at 2 tomorrow; the appointment is confirmed.
I'm meeting the manager now; please wait.
I meet the manager yesterday.

feedback.explanation: Tomorrow + confirmed appointment rende il futuro organizzato inequivocabile.

questions.title: Sistema la negativa
questions.prompt: Correggi: We not meeting them tonight.
questions.learning_objective: Form a negative future arrangement using Present Continuous.

accepted_answers: We are not meeting them tonight.

feedback.explanation: Negativa: are not / aren't + meeting.

questions.title: Chiedi dell'accordo
questions.prompt: Metti le parole nell'ordine corretto.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Present Continuous future arrangement question.

feedback.explanation: When + are + you + meeting + Sara?

exercises.title: Present Continuous for future — Allenati
exercises.description: Pratica appuntamenti, prenotazioni e accordi futuri già organizzati.
exercises.instructions: Ogni frase deve avere un contesto futuro abbastanza chiaro da non sembrare un'azione in corso adesso.

sections.title: Usa gli accordi concreti
sections.instructions: Controlla contesto futuro e forma completa.

questions.title: Agenda di domani
questions.prompt: Complete with the Present Continuous.
questions.learning_objective: Produce fixed future arrangements with different subjects.

content.text_template: Tomorrow, I [[blank_1]] (meet) the tutor at 4 and my parents [[blank_2]] (fly) to Madrid at 8.

feedback.explanation: Contesti già organizzati: am meeting / are flying.

questions.title: L'appuntamento è già confermato
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural reply.
questions.learning_objective: Use Present Continuous naturally for a confirmed appointment.

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: Are you free at five tomorrow?

turns.speaker: Elisa
turns.text: No, sorry. I booked something yesterday.

options.text: I'm seeing the dentist at five.
I seeing the dentist at five.
I'm see the dentist at five.

feedback.explanation: Prenotazione + ora precisa = arrangement futuro.

questions.title: Il contesto decide
questions.prompt: Which sentence describes something happening now, not a future arrangement?
questions.learning_objective: Distinguish present action from future arrangement by context.

options.text: I'm talking to my teacher right now.
I'm talking to my teacher at 3 tomorrow; the meeting is booked.
We're flying to Paris on Saturday; the tickets are booked.

feedback.explanation: Right now segnala l'azione presente; le altre frasi hanno dettagli futuri organizzati.

questions.title: Due errori di forma
questions.prompt: Correct: They is leave for Rome on Friday morning; the train is booked.
questions.learning_objective: Correct auxiliary agreement and -ing form in a future arrangement.

accepted_answers: They are leaving for Rome on Friday morning; the train is booked.
They're leaving for Rome on Friday morning; the train is booked.

feedback.explanation: They → are; leave → leaving.

questions.title: Una domanda sul programma
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a future arrangement question with correct inversion.

feedback.explanation: Where + are + you + staying + this weekend?

questions.title: Traduci l'appuntamento
questions.prompt: Domani alle quattro incontro il mio tutor in biblioteca; abbiamo già fissato l'appuntamento.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a Present Continuous future arrangement with clear organisational context.

accepted_answers: I'm meeting my tutor in the library at four tomorrow; we've already arranged the meeting.
I am meeting my tutor in the library at four tomorrow; we have already arranged the meeting.

feedback.explanation: Ora, luogo e accordo già fissato rendono naturale il Present Continuous futuro.

questions.title: Quali sono arrangement completi?
questions.prompt: Select all sentences that are grammatical and clearly describe organised future arrangements.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one answer.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise grammatical future arrangements with sufficient future context.

options.text: We're meeting the coach at 6 tomorrow; it's in the calendar.
She's flying to Berlin on Monday; the flight is booked.
They meeting us tomorrow at 8.
I'm talking to him right now.

feedback.explanation: Serve forma completa e un contesto futuro organizzato.

questions.title: Domanda e risposta
questions.prompt: Complete the exchange about tomorrow's schedule.
questions.learning_objective: Coordinate question and affirmative response in a future arrangement.

content.text_template: A: [[blank_1]] you meeting the client tomorrow? B: Yes, I [[blank_2]] seeing her at 11.

feedback.explanation: Are you meeting...? I am seeing...

exercises.title: Present Continuous for future — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Applica gli arrangement futuri in formati tipici di una verifica scolastica.

sections.title: Verifica scolastica
sections.instructions: Controlla sia l'organizzazione del contesto sia la forma.

questions.title: Complete the diary
questions.prompt: Use the Present Continuous for the fixed arrangements.
questions.learning_objective: Produce future arrangements in a school-style diary context.

content.text_template: Friday: I [[blank_1]] (meet) the tutor at 3. Saturday: we [[blank_2]] (travel) to Florence on the 8:10 train. Sunday: my cousins [[blank_3]] (come) for lunch at 1.

feedback.explanation: Gli orari e gli accordi concreti rendono tutti e tre gli eventi arrangement futuri.

questions.title: Correct the mistake
questions.prompt: Correct: We is meeting the teacher at 9 tomorrow.
questions.learning_objective: Correct auxiliary agreement in a future arrangement.

accepted_answers: We are meeting the teacher at 9 tomorrow.
We're meeting the teacher at 9 tomorrow.

feedback.explanation: We → are meeting.

questions.title: Make a question
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a future arrangement question in school format.

feedback.explanation: Who + are + you + meeting + after school?

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: Sabato mattina partiamo alle sette; i biglietti del treno sono già prenotati.
questions.instructions: Translate using the Present Continuous for the arrangement.
questions.learning_objective: Translate a clearly booked future arrangement.

accepted_answers: We're leaving at seven on Saturday morning; the train tickets are already booked.
We are leaving at seven on Saturday morning; the train tickets are already booked.

feedback.explanation: Orario + biglietti già prenotati = arrangement concreto.

questions.title: Choose the best sentence
questions.prompt: Which sentence clearly describes a future arrangement?
questions.learning_objective: Identify a future arrangement from sufficient context.

options.text: I'm meeting the head teacher at 10 tomorrow; the appointment is confirmed.
I'm speaking to the head teacher right now.
I meet the head teacher yesterday.

feedback.explanation: Tomorrow + confirmed appointment rende il futuro organizzato chiaro.

questions.title: Complete the exchange
questions.prompt: Choose the correct forms.
questions.learning_objective: Coordinate future arrangement question and negative response.

content.text_template: A: [[blank_1]] you working tomorrow morning? B: No, I [[blank_2]].

feedback.explanation: Are you working...? No, I'm not.

exercises.title: Present Continuous for future — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma su arrangement, contesto futuro, forma, domande e negative.
exercises.instructions: Completa senza aiuti. Il feedback arriva alla fine.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Valuta se il contesto mostra davvero un arrangement futuro.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: The table is booked for 8 p.m. tomorrow. Which sentence fits best?
questions.learning_objective: Choose Present Continuous for a booked arrangement.

options.text: We're having dinner there at eight tomorrow.
We having dinner there tomorrow.
We're have dinner there tomorrow.

feedback.explanation: Prenotazione + ora precisa = arrangement futuro.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.prompt: Complete the confirmed plans.
questions.learning_objective: Produce future arrangement forms with correct auxiliary and -ing spelling.

content.text_template: Tomorrow, I [[blank_1]] (see) the doctor at 9 and my friends [[blank_2]] (come) over at 7.

feedback.explanation: I → am seeing; friends → are coming.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.prompt: Correct: My parents is flying to Naples on Monday; the tickets are booked.
questions.learning_objective: Correct auxiliary agreement in a future arrangement.

accepted_answers: My parents are flying to Naples on Monday; the tickets are booked.
My parents are flying to Naples on Monday; the tickets have been booked.

feedback.explanation: Parents = they → are flying.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a future arrangement information question.

feedback.explanation: When + are + they + leaving + tomorrow?

questions.title: Item 5
questions.prompt: Domani alle tre non incontro il professore: l'appuntamento è stato cancellato.
questions.instructions: Translate using the Present Continuous future negative.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a negative future arrangement with clear context.

accepted_answers: I'm not meeting the teacher at three tomorrow; the appointment has been cancelled.
I am not meeting the teacher at three tomorrow; the appointment was cancelled.

feedback.explanation: Negativa: am not meeting; il contesto futuro resta chiaro.

questions.title: Item 6
questions.prompt: Select all sentences that are grammatical and clearly refer to fixed future arrangements.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one answer.
questions.learning_objective: Discriminate fixed future arrangements from present actions and malformed structures.

options.text: I'm seeing the dentist at 4 tomorrow; it's booked.
We're meeting the team at the office on Friday at 10.
I talking to the dentist right now.
She's studying right now.

feedback.explanation: Serve sia forma corretta sia contesto futuro organizzato.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural reply.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a confirmed future arrangement in dialogue.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Can you study with us at four tomorrow?

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: I can't. I already booked something.

options.text: I'm seeing the doctor at four.
I seeing the doctor at four.
I'm see the doctor at four.

feedback.explanation: Già prenotato + ora precisa = arrangement futuro.

questions.title: Item 8
questions.prompt: Complete the future schedule exchange.
questions.learning_objective: Coordinate arrangement question and affirmative response with correct auxiliaries.

content.text_template: A: [[blank_1]] Sara meeting us at 7? B: Yes, she [[blank_2]] coming straight from work.

feedback.explanation: Is Sara meeting...? She is coming...

questions.title: Item 9
questions.prompt: Correct: Do you meeting the tutor tomorrow at 5?
questions.learning_objective: Replace do with the correct be auxiliary in an arrangement question.

accepted_answers: Are you meeting the tutor tomorrow at 5?
Are you meeting the tutor tomorrow at five?

feedback.explanation: Present Continuous question: Are you meeting...?

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: Which sentence is least clearly a future arrangement?
questions.learning_objective: Identify insufficient future-arrangement context.

options.text: I'm talking to Elena.
I'm talking to Elena at 6 tomorrow; we booked the call.
We're leaving on the 7:30 train on Saturday; the tickets are booked.

feedback.explanation: Senza un contesto futuro, I'm talking to Elena può semplicemente descrivere adesso.

questions.title: Item 11
questions.prompt: Sabato partiamo per Roma alle otto; i biglietti sono prenotati. Domenica non incontriamo Luca: ha cancellato l'appuntamento.
questions.instructions: Translate both arrangements using the Present Continuous.
questions.learning_objective: Produce affirmative and negative future arrangements with explicit organisational context.

accepted_answers: We're leaving for Rome at eight on Saturday; the tickets are booked. We aren't meeting Luca on Sunday; he cancelled the appointment.
We are leaving for Rome at eight on Saturday; the tickets are booked. We are not meeting Luca on Sunday; he cancelled the appointment.

feedback.explanation: Entrambe sono situazioni organizzate: una confermata, una cancellata. La forma resta Present Continuous con contesto futuro.
